types.label: Bug
types.summary: A defect an agent found while doing unrelated work, not an external tracker bug.
types.when_to_use: File one when you found a defect while doing unrelated work and it is not an external tracker issue. Record where it lives, how to reproduce it, and who it hurts; one independent reproduction separates it from a misreading. Do not use this for a flake, a confirmed CI failure, or a GitHub-mirrored bug.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.help: File, symbol, or other locator for the defect

fields.name: repro
fields.label: Repro
fields.help: Steps or command that reproduce the defect

fields.name: impact
fields.label: Impact
fields.help: Who or what the defect breaks, and how badly

types.label: CI failure
types.summary: A confirmed true test or lint failure, not a flake.
types.when_to_use: File one when a test or lint failed and you confirmed it is a true failure, not a flake. Record the pytest node ID, the failing SHA if known, and why this is not intermittent. Use flake instead when a rerun on the same tree passed.

fields.name: node_id
fields.label: Test node ID
fields.help: The pytest node ID, e.g. tests/foo.py::test_bar

fields.name: sha
fields.label: SHA
fields.help: Commit SHA where the failure was observed

fields.name: why_not_flake
fields.label: Why not a flake
fields.help: Why this is a confirmed true failure rather than a flake

types.label: Feature
types.summary: An out-of-scope product idea that should not become a wish list.
types.when_to_use: File one when you discovered a product or capability idea that is outside the current task or epic. State the proposal and why it is out of scope for the work you were doing. Do not file one for in-scope follow-up that belongs on the current epic.
types.create_refusal: Agents never create this type with `sase bead create` or `/sase_new_task` where it is not agent-creatable. Do not refile the idea under another type: record it as a `PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP:` note on the bead you are working, or raise it with the project owner.

fields.name: proposal
fields.label: Proposal
fields.help: What should exist that is outside the current work

fields.name: why_out_of_scope
fields.label: Why out of scope
fields.help: Why this does not belong on the current task or epic

types.label: Feature flag
types.summary: A SASE feature flag's removal bead: the dossier for one temporary boolean route.
types.when_to_use: Agents never create this type with `sase bead create` or `/sase_new_task`. Run `sase flag new <key>`, which creates this bead, validates its fields, and prints the registry entry to paste. One bead per registered flag; close it only in the change that deletes the flag's disabled branch and its registry entry.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Key
fields.help: The snake_case registry key, e.g. prettier_enabled

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.help: beta is off by default; sunset is on by default and guards a doomed branch

fields.name: when_enabled
fields.label: On
fields.help: What the code does with this flag enabled

fields.name: when_disabled
fields.label: Off
fields.help: What the code does with this flag disabled; this branch is deleted at removal

fields.name: remove_when
fields.label: Remove when
fields.help: What must be true before the disabled branch can be deleted

fields.name: remove_by_date
fields.label: Remove by date
fields.help: Calendar removal threshold, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: remove_by_release
fields.label: Remove by release
fields.help: Release removal threshold, e.g. 0.18.0

types.label: Flaky test
types.summary: A test that fails and then passes on an unchanged tree.
types.when_to_use: File one when a test or lint failed, a rerun on the same tree passed, and you did not cause the failure. Record the fail rate and whether it reproduces serially. Use ci instead when the failure is confirmed and reproducible.

fields.name: node_id
fields.label: Test node ID
fields.help: The pytest node ID, e.g. tests/foo.py::test_bar

fields.name: repro_cmd
fields.label: Repro command
fields.help: Command that reproduced the intermittent failure

fields.name: evidence
fields.label: Evidence
fields.help: Fail/pass observations, fail rate, and serial vs parallel

types.label: GitHub
types.summary: A GitHub issue mirrored into a task bead; agents never create this type.
types.when_to_use: Agents never create this type. Beads of it are created by the external issue mirror when it covers a GitHub issue. Do not file one from `sase bead create` or `/sase_new_task`.

types.label: Memory
types.summary: A sase memory note or skill that is out of date.
types.when_to_use: File one when a sase memory file or skill contains out-of-date information that should be updated. Closing still requires explicit user permission plus `sase memory init`. Record the memory path and the proposed change.

fields.name: path
fields.label: Path
fields.help: Memory note path relative to memory/, e.g. sase_beads.md

fields.name: proposed_change
fields.label: Proposed change
fields.help: The correction the memory note should receive
